release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.27 upgrades the fifth Tasks module into two explicit Target session-jar workflows so users do not have to guess which cookie/session state belongs where: Account Session Cookies preserve normal logged-in Target account/session state, while Add-to-Cart Session Cookies preserve normal established Target cart/session state. The module adds persistent jar inventory and counts, editable jar task records with batch creation up to 50 records, browser selection, headed/headless mode where supported, optional saved proxy-group binding, Open/Stop lifecycle, persistent browser profiles, Target-task binding, and automatic jar binding from the Target task creation form. Proxy-backed jars require a Target task binding before opening so the jar and its bound Target task resolve the same deterministic proxy endpoint rather than silently mixing network identities. Target Engine and compatible Edge/Chrome-backed jars are marked sync-ready for Target task reuse; alternate browser profiles remain session-only where the retail runtime cannot safely consume the same profile. The jar metadata store does not persist raw cookie values and the new module does not add browser cookie-database reads, challenge-token extraction/export, verification solving, Shape forgery, or a new remote-debugging path. PR #339 passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight including final composed JavaScript syntax, UI/DOM, Go vet/tests, race and vulnerability gates, Windows Consumer E2E with the exact native Windows EXE and real Wails/WebView2 shell, Member Build Boundary with the exact compiled member candidate, and both Go and JavaScript/TypeScript CodeQL security gates before merge.
